This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, which must be performed on a weekly, semiannual, and annually 
bases as indicated by W1, M6 and Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Haytham Hemdan, 
reviewed by eng. Mohamed Abbass Ahmed, revised by EDEPC quality control 
eng. Adel Abdul Kader El Naggar, approved by eng. Tarek Youssef Ali, Head Sector of 
Ayoun Moussa Power Station.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector.

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance stuff 
 should carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the appropriate safety equipment as safety shoes and helmet

It will be necessary to wear high voltage proof gloves for brush holder 
 removal from or insertion into the carrier ring while the unit is in excited 
 condition

To ensure proper field current transfer during checks and maintenance 
 activities, remove only one plug-in brush holder at a time for each polarity.
 Removing the next brush holder is only permissible after the first one has 
 been reinserted and positively participated in the field current transfer.

The carbon brushes

Introduction

inspection I1, which must be performed on a weekly, semiannual, and annually

certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection &

 condition
To ensure proper field current transfer during checks and maintenance 
 activities, remove only one plug-in brush holder at a time for each polarity.
 Removing the next brush holder is only permissible after the first one has 
 been reinserted and positively participated in the field current transfer.

Checking Slip Rings
Heavily contaminated slip 
rings have to be cleaned during unit outages.
Clean brushes and dry
